subject: Intro + demo request — Redwood for FinLytics (support summarization / search)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo request: Redwood for FinLytics support summarization

Hi Laura,

We signed up for Redwood yesterday (quick self-serve) and I'm interested in a short demo to evaluate using Redwood for two things:

- Summarizing incoming customer support threads for our agents (250-1,200 token inputs)
- Semantic search / embeddings for our knowledge base and agent routing

A few quick notes:
- We expect ~3M queries/month initially across both features (spikes during product launches).
- Latency matters for agents — target p95 <= 350ms for generation.
- We are an early-stage fintech (FinLytics) — security/compliance is important; have basic SOC2 questions.

Would love a 30-minute demo + brief technical Q&A. Our team is PST-based and available next Tue/Wed mornings. I'm including Priya (PM) on the thread.

Attached a quick CSV with sample weekly traffic (traffic-export.csv).

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Product, FinLytics
samir@finlytics.ai
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Priya Khatri <priya@finlytics.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 10:05:30 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood for FinLytics support summarization

Hi Samir — great to meet you, and thanks for signing up!

Happy to run a 30-minute walkthrough focused on latency, batching behavior, and the embedding workflows. A couple of quick qualification questions so we tailor the session and bring the right folks: 

1) Primary demo goal — agent-facing summarization, embeddings for KB search, or both (what should we prioritize in 30m)?
2) Typical request size (tokens in prompt + expected generation) and distribution (is 1k tokens common or rare?)
3) Expected concurrency / QPS during peak launches (you mentioned spikes — any numbers?)
4) Are you using a server-side integration today or experimenting with client-side? (SDKs / stack: Python, Node, etc.)
5) Timeline for a POC — are you trying to run something in 2–4 weeks, or is this exploratory?
6) Any compliance blockers (SOC2 evidence, VPC/private deployment needs)?

I created a few open slots here: https://calendly.com/redwood/laura-30 — if none fit, tell me preferred windows (PST).

I've attached a short demo checklist that shows what we'll cover and what info helps speed a POC (demo-checklist.pdf).

Looping in Jordan Blake (solutions engineer) to cover integration/throughput questions.

Cheers,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
From: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Khatri <priya@finlytics.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 11:18:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood for FinLytics support summarization

On Wed, Nov 3, 2027 at 10:05 AM Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com> wrote:
> I created a few open slots here: https://calendly.com/redwood/laura-30 — if none fit, tell me preferred windows (PST).

Thanks, Laura — appreciate the quick reply. Answers inline below: 

1) Prioritize agent-facing summarization; we can spend the last 10 minutes on embeddings.
2) Typical ticket: 400–800 tokens incoming, generation ~100–300 tokens. We have longer enterprise tickets occasionally (~1.5k) but rare.
3) Concurrency: baseline ~30–40 QPS across agents, spikes to ~250 QPS during rollouts (short bursts of 30–90 minutes).
4) Server-side Python; we have a small microservice layer handling routing.
5) POC timeline: aim to have a POC running in 3 weeks to evaluate SLA and cost.
6) Compliance: SOC2 questions — we can share a checklist; we may need Private options if certain audit items require it.

Preferred demo windows: Tue/Wed next week, 9:00–11:30am PST. Priya and I prefer mornings.

Attached is the traffic CSV I mentioned.

Samir
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Priya Khatri <priya@finlytics.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 15:02:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood for FinLytics support summarization

Thanks for the details — super helpful. Based on what you shared, Jordan and I will prepare:

- A short walkthrough of our agent summarization pattern and latency optimizations (prefix caching, continuous batching).
- Embeddings demo showing kb search and cosine similarity tradeoffs.
- Suggested starting config for throughput: multi-worker pool + 8k context model variant, and an estimate of token costs for 3M/mo.

Proposed slots (30m, PST):
- Tue Nov 9 — 9:30am or 10:30am
- Wed Nov 10 — 9:00am or 11:00am

If one of those works I can send a calendar invite and include a quick pre-demo intake form (pre-demo-intake-form.pdf) — filling it out helps us run a hands-on POC faster. Also, are there any internal firewalls that will block our shared test endpoints?

Best,
Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

Cc: Priya Khatri <priya@finlytics.ai>

Hi Laura — quick update. We have an internal all-hands that ran over (and a US holiday moved some folks' schedules). We still want the demo, but need to push to the week after next.

Would you have availability the week of Nov 22? Morning PST still best for us (9–11am). Also, one follow-up: during the POC we may need a short-lived increase to capacity for load testing (2–3 hours). Does Redwood support temporary burst increases for Dedicated/Hosted?

Thanks,
Samir

Thanks for the heads-up, Samir — absolutely we can accommodate. We offer burst capacity on hosted plans (and configurable burst/pool increases for Dedicated). Jordan will outline the ops steps and expected lead time for a 2–3 hour soak during the POC.

I have availability Nov 22 at 9:30am PST and Nov 23 at 10:00am PST — want me to lock in Nov 22 9:30am? If so I'll send the calendar invite and include the intake form.

Also attaching the short demo checklist so your team knows what to have ready (demo-checklist.pdf).

—Laura
